d:
Hamare yutyub chainal yogvale men aapka svagat hai.
Welcome to our YouTube Channel YOGAWALE.
Agar aap bhi yog karna shuru karna chahte hain to yah vidiyo aapke lie hai, is vidiyo men mainne aapko bahut hi aasan khare hokar yog aasan batae hain jinhen aap ghar par hi kar sakte hain.
If you also want to start doing yoga then this video is for you, in this video I have told you very easy standing yoga asanas which you can do at home.
Kuchh aur jaruri vidiyo jinhen dekhkar aap apne sharir ko svasth rakh sakenge.
